name: PlantUML Diagrams
description: Renders PlantUML .puml source to SVG via a local `java -jar plantuml.jar` subprocess. Separately installable — requires a JRE + plantuml.jar (run `node setup.mjs`). Falls back to the code block when unavailable.
author: Glassbox

requirements.label: Java (JRE 8+)
requirements.hint: Install a Java runtime — e.g. `brew install openjdk` (macOS), `apt install default-jre` (Linux), or from adoptium.net — then click Install again.
